prerequisites: Completion of at least 120 ECTS of the study plan.
Not having completed the entire study load of the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive education of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate the knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate as graduates, contrasting and applying the acquired knowledge.
Promote the development of students' decision-making capacity and critical spirit.

syllabus_topics: Specification of educational objectives and professional activities.
Particular conditions of each internship placement.
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Monitoring Grade. A minimum of 4 points is required in both the Internship Report Grade and the Monitoring Grade to pass the course. The final grade must be greater than or equal to 5 to pass. If the minimum in the Internship Report Grade and/or Monitoring Grade is not met, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. Extraordinary calls follow the same procedure.
